name: Lord of the Manor
source:
[B]"Flax...my obliviously-handsome, socially-not-quite-there-but-working-on-it equine friend: even you can't fail to drown in a sea of dick at this place."[/b]

Step into the hooves of Flax, semi-awkward stallion and recent university graduate. After four hard years of study, you are finally free and ready to start doing whatever you wish with your life—right after you take advantage of the surprise getaway gifted to you by a friend.

Travel to the beautiful African-inspired holiday town of Paardenrust, rich in history, natural splendour, and gorgeous males. Meet the inhabitants, get to know them, and decide if there's any you'd like to know even better. Spend your leisure time exploring the ancient manor house, enjoying the many activities in the town and surrounds, or simply wooing one of the many handsome residents. What more could you want from a holiday?

But, be aware: something mysterious is afoot in Paardenrust, and if you choose to get involved, you may find that you become intimately entwined in the next chapter of the town's strange story...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250724091719/https://zaggynorse.itch.io/lord-of-the-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[B]“亚麻……我的马朋友，虽然外表英俊，社交能力差，但在努力工作：即使你在这个地方也不能不淹死在鸡巴的海洋里。”[/b]

踏入亚麻的蹄子，亚麻是一种半笨拙的种马，也是刚毕业的大学毕业生。经过四年的艰苦学习，你终于获得了自由，并准备好开始做任何你想做的事情——就在你享受朋友送给你的惊喜假期之后。

前往美丽的非洲风情度假小镇帕登鲁斯特 (Paardenrust)，这里历史悠久，自然风光绚丽，还有美丽的男性。与居民见面，了解他们，然后决定是否有任何你想进一步了解的人。你可以利用闲暇时间探索古老的庄园，享受城镇和周边地区的众多活动，或者只是向众多英俊的居民中的一位求爱。你还想从假期中得到什么？

但是，请注意：帕登鲁斯特正在发生一些神秘的事情，如果你选择参与其中，你可能会发现自己紧密地卷入了该镇奇怪故事的下一章……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250724091719/https://zaggynorse.itch.io/lord-of-the-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
